name: Editor sidebar panel for post meta
query: Add a 'Subtitle' field to the post editor sidebar that saves to post meta and shows under the title on the frontend.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Register the meta with register_post_meta(), show_in_rest, sanitize_callback and auth_callback
Step 3: Build a PluginDocumentSettingPanel (from @wordpress/editor) using useEntityProp for meta
Step 4: Enqueue on enqueue_block_editor_assets with the generated .asset.php
Step 5: Print the subtitle on the frontend escaped with esc_html()
success_criteria: No separate save request; meta saves with the post
Meta registered with show_in_rest and an auth_callback
